description: This Java test class 'EventHttpIT' performs integration testing for uploading events to an HTTP adapter within the Eclipse Hono project. It extends a base test class and uses JUnit 5 with Vertx extensions to run asynchronous tests, verifying event consumption and message properties.

classes.name: EventHttpIT
classes.description: Integration test class for uploading events to the HTTP adapter, verifying event consumption and message properties.

methods.name: getEndpointUri
methods.description: Returns the URI endpoint for the test, derived from EventConstants.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates an event consumer for a given tenant and message handler, returning a Vert.x Future.

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Checks that the message has the 'durable' property set to true.
